subject: LunarBank continuity review and closure packet
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sangeeta Rao <sangeeta.rao@lunarbank.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: LunarBank continuity review and closure packet

Hi Sangeeta,

Thanks again for your patience while we completed our investigation. Attached is a concise closure packet for the degradation event you observed on Apr 1 — it contains: a one-page RCA summary, a detailed timeline CSV, and step-by-step verification instructions for your SREs.

Key takeaway (short): a transient inconsistency in the token-store sharding layer caused a small percentage of in-flight sessions to miss prefix cache population, which increased downstream cache misses and produced elevated per-request latency for ~18 minutes. We identified the causal code path, have deployed a fix, and have added compensating guards to prevent recurrence.

What we did, at a glance:
- Hotfix deployed (v2.14.3) to avoid async shard flush race (deployed Apr 2, 02:30 UTC)
- Backfilled affected cache entries and reconciled KV state (completed Apr 2, 03:10 UTC)
- Added a safety throttle on shard rebalancer to avoid overlapping mutations (deployed Apr 4)
- Added enhanced telemetry and an automated alert for the exact mismatch pattern (ETA: Apr 10)

Requested next steps from LunarBank:
1) Run the attached verification_instructions.md and reply with the test results by Apr 7.
2) If you want a short joint verification call, propose a 30-min slot and we’ll join.
3) Let us know whether you need a SOC2-style evidence package for this specific window — we can assemble logs and audit traces.

Attachments: lunarbank_rca_summary_v1.pdf, incident_timeline_20280403.csv, verification_instructions.md

Apologies for the impact — we own this and are prioritizing follow-through. I’ve cc’d Grace and Marissa who are helping coordinate telemetry verification and long-term mitigations.

Best,

Tessa Morgan
Customer Reliability Lead
Redwood Inference
T: +1 415 555 0192
From: Sangeeta Rao <sangeeta.rao@lunarbank.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: LunarBank Ops <ops@lunarbank.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Apr 2028 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: LunarBank continuity review and closure packet

Tessa — thank you for the packet. Quick questions from our ops team after a first pass: 

- Can you confirm whether any user PII was present in the affected cache keys during the mismatch window? We need this for our compliance log.
- For the verification steps, do your instructions require any elevated permissions on our side? We prefer read-only procedures where possible.

We will schedule a verification run on Apr 6 and will share results. Please advise on the PII question ASAP as that affects our internal comms.

Thanks,
Sangeeta Rao
Head of Platform Reliability, LunarBank
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Apr 2028 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: LunarBank continuity review and closure packet (internal)

Tessa / Grace — forwarding LunarBank's questions so we have a shared response draft.

Draft answers and evidence we can provide:
- PII exposure: preliminary answer = no. The token-store keys are namespace-prefixed IDs; we verified schema and logs for the window and did not find raw PII values (we’ll attach a redacted extraction). We should include the audit trace showing key types and counts.
- Verification permissions: the attached verification instructions are read-only and use existing API tokens. We will add a read-only test harness and a sample curl that uses your existing client token; no elevated access required.

Action owners:
- Marissa: assemble redacted audit extraction and attach to reply (ETA: 4/4 EOD).
- Grace: add the read-only curl examples to verification_instructions.md and upload to the Drive link (ETA: 4/5 11:00 PDT).
- Tessa: send the customer-facing reply once attachments are ready.

Marissa
Senior Technical Program Manager, Customer Reliability
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sangeeta Rao <sangeeta.rao@lunarbank.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Apr 2028 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: LunarBank continuity review and closure packet — final package and next steps

Hi Sangeeta,

Following up with the finalized package and answers to your questions: we’ve attached the redacted audit extraction and a read-only verification harness. Short answers first:

- PII exposure: No customer-identifiable data was present in the affected token-store keys during the window. The attached audit extract (redacted) shows key schemas and counts; we’ve also included an integrity hash (sha256) for the extract.
- Verification: all verification steps are read-only and require no elevated privileges. We included a small curl-based harness and a Postman collection for your convenience.

What we’ve delivered in this message:
1) lunarbank_rca_summary_v1.pdf — concise RCA, root cause, and long-term mitigations.
2) incident_timeline_20280403.csv — per-minute timeline of events and actions.
3) verification_instructions.md — read-only test harness, curl examples, and expected results.
4) redacted_audit_extract_sha256.txt — hash: d2b2c3f1a94c... (attached inline).

Planned permanent controls (summary):
- Merge-time invariants on token-store writes to prevent partial population (Q2 development).
- Observability: a high-fidelity rule in our alerting pipeline to detect the mismatch pattern; will be enabled Apr 10.
- Operational runbooks: an automated reconciliation job and playbook for quick rehydration (ETA: Apr 18).

Verification meeting: We’re available Mon Apr 8 at 09:00 PDT or Tue Apr 9 at 14:00 PDT for a 30-min verification walkthrough. Please send your preferred slot.

Attachments: lunarbank_rca_summary_v1.pdf, incident_timeline_20280403.csv, verification_instructions.md, redacted_audit_extract_sha256.txt

Let me know if you need any additional artifacts. We appreciate the partnership and will keep you updated as the longer-term controls are delivered.

Best,

Tessa Morgan
Customer Reliability Lead
Redwood Inference
